name: Elemental Magic
notes: Used by the Arabian Tomb Raiders Mystic. Judgement calls: Skin of Stone's -1 Initiative doubled to -2 I; Burning Hand's 'set on fire on 4+' converted to 7+; Strength tests left as written.

spells.name: Riding the Wind
spells.text: Cast at the start of the caster's Movement phase. The caster may move up to 12+D6" anywhere on the battlefield, ignoring intervening terrain; this replaces his normal movement. May not end in base contact with an enemy. He may shoot as normal (-1 to hit for having moved).

spells.name: Skin of Stone
spells.text: Any friendly warrior within 6" gains +2 to his armour save but suffers -2 Initiative. May be maintained each turn if the warrior stays within 6" and the caster passes a Difficulty test; if the caster is more than 6" away in the Recovery phase it wears off. Only one warrior may be affected at a time, but the caster may cast other spells while maintaining it.

spells.name: Burning Hand
spells.text: Cast at the start of the Combat phase. The caster sacrifices all his normal attacks to make one hand-to-hand attack at Strength 10 causing 2 wounds. If it hits, the enemy is set on fire on a roll of 7+. Lasts one round only.

spells.name: Quicksand
spells.text: Cast on any warrior within 6". The area within 3" of the target is flooded until the start of the caster's next Recovery phase. All warriors in it must pass a Strength test or be unable to move. Warriors in combat cannot attack but may defend themselves.

spells.name: Storm of Magic
spells.text: Target any warrior within 12". The target takes one Strength 10 hit. Armour saves may be taken as normal.

spells.name: Blessing of the Elements
spells.text: In the post-battle sequence the player may re-roll any one die or modify one die by +1/-1. If the caster was taken out of action this spell may not be cast.
